text:
anya: Quick sync — prioritization for onboarding 'orchid-12' (3B) + quant experiments. Need a prioritized score this week so we can align with roadmap. Who can own scoring?

jordan: I can take scoring. Proposed rubric: perf delta vs baseline (latency P95), cost/TU, eval QA regressions (answer correctness/hallucination), runtime readiness (kernels/ops), and vendor dependencies. Short scores 1-10.

sam: +1. Add 'canary rollout complexity' as a tie-breaker.

leo: FYI ran quick int8 / awq runs on dev A100:
```
int8_dynamic: latency_p95 +12%, throughput +18%, qa_drop 0.9%
awq-quant: latency_p95 +4%, throughput +10%, qa_drop 0.4%
notes: awq uses custom kernels not yet in runtime
```

anya: thanks — can you link the perf logs?

leo: ciara-bot posted them: https://ci.internal/runs/orchid-12/1755

ciara-bot: Run summary: Orchid-12 quant sweep (run/1755) — int8_dynamic, awq-quant. Artifacts: model artifacts, eval reports, perf traces.

jordan: based on those numbers I'd prelim-score: int8_dynamic 5/10, awq-quant 7/10. Main blocker: runtime kernel support for AWQ for private/dedicated.

sam: I'll spin up an infra checklist. Draft:
```
- model card + expected delta
- quant config + seed
- perf harness (helm + rps)
- KV cache smoke tests
- canary rollout playbook + fallback to fp16
```

anya: add 'regression detectors' alerting on eval set drop >1.0% and 'hallucination spike'.

leo: note: AWQ had a small regression on multi-step reasoning test — 2/50 cases. Might be prompt-sensitive.

jordan: ok let's scope: prioritize AWQ bring-up for Dedicated next sprint if sam/infra can validate KV cache and kernels. int8_dynamic keep as lower priority patch.

sam: assigning tasks:
- jordan: scoring doc + spreadsheet (by EOD Thu)
- leo: reproduce AWQ regression across 3 seeds and share failing examples
- sam: infra harness + canary JIRA
- anya: update roadmap + stakeholder note

jordan: ack. I'll add a short rubric table and publish link here.

ciara-bot: Reminder: weekly-model-review in #eng-ml Friday 10:00am. Agenda slot: 'Orchid-12 quant bring-up' added.

jordan: can we move to Thu? :thinking_face:

anya: Fri is better for ops attendance. :thumbsup:

sam: created JIRA RN-3421 for canary + RN-3422 for infra checklist.

leo: quick ask — for the scoring doc, should we weight QA higher than latency? My preference: QA 40%, latency 25%, cost 20%, runtime readiness 15%.

anya: I agree with that weighting. That will tip us towards AWQ if QA holds.

jordan: perfect. I'll include weights and a sample scoring row. Publishing link in thread when ready.

sam: cool. anyone wants to pair on the KV cache smoke tests Wed afternoon?

leo: I can pair Wed 2pm.

anya: thanks all. We'll reconvene in the weekly review with finalized scores.
